title: Cotensor decompositions for comodules over graded vertex operator coalgebras
summary: Let $V$ be a graded vertex operator coalgebra and $\mathcal{C}$ the category of admissible $V$-comodules. We first give the construction of contragredient comodule of an admissible $V$-comodule. We then introduce cointertwining operators among admissible $V$-comodules. Using cointertwining operators, we define the cotensor decomposition of an admissible $V$-comodule by a universal property. Finally, we prove that the complexified Grothendieck group $\mathbb{K}[\mathcal{C}]=\mathbb{C}\otimes_{\mathbb{Z}}K[\mathcal{C}]$ is a cocommutative coassociative coalgebra.
